name: get-ca
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import json,subprocess,sys,re
plan={"url":"https://arxiv.org/pdf/1503.08876","routes":["330067"],"destination":"sources/1503.08876.pdf","source_identity":"Asymptotic size of covering arrays: an application of entropy compression, arXiv:1503.08876","purpose":"Read the actual printed statement of the strength-2 covering array limit d(2,v)=v/2 bearing on 330067"}
p='plans/get-ca.json'
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','write_lane.py',p],input=json.dumps(plan,indent=1),text=True,capture_output=True);print(r.stdout,r.stderr)
if r.returncode: sys.exit(r.returncode)
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','source_get_guard.py',p],text=True,capture_output=True);print(r.stdout,r.stderr)
if r.returncode: sys.exit(r.returncode)
t=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout','sources/1503.08876.pdf','-'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60)
print(t.returncode,len(t.stdout))
w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','write_lane.py','sources/1503.08876.txt'],input=t.stdout,text=True,capture_output=True);print(w.stdout,w.stderr)
print(t.stdout[:5200])
s=open('sources/1503.02380.txt').read()
print('=== SCC source RANGE 0-3800'); print(s[0:3800])
print('=== SCC source RANGE 16400-18200'); print(s[16400:18200])
sys.exit(t.returncode or w.returncode)
